lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Then it falls. I will not beg. When you go back up those stairs, look at what you kept.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: You are letting my people die on schedule. I will remember that. I am going to remember both versions.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Something is wrong. The Wardens are not in the valley. Listen. They are inside the walls.
